preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].
There are exactly n-1 edges forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The number of queries made does not exceed ⌊ n/2 ⌋.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queried_pairs)
postconditions.description: Each query involves two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].
The root vertex r is correctly identified.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in vertices)
invariants.description: All vertices are within the range [1, n].
